source: scripts/build-program-projects.mjs (plus scripts/fetch-fossee.mjs and scripts/fetch-vercel-oss.mjs); every shard is generated, none hand-edited
note: The project archive for the 13 programs this site tracks. Each entry points at one JSON file whose rows use the same short column names as /data/otherProjects.json (y,u,t,o,s,tt,tp,b,m,url,program, plus stars/lang/license only where a GitHub API response supplied them) and whose `projects` field is exactly the number of rows on disk. `unit` is the program's own word for a row and the programs are not comparable through it: an accepted GSoC project, a proposed Season of KDE idea, a 24 Pull Requests wishlist repository and an MLH fork are four different facts. `evidence` says how much to trust the list - archive = the program's own record, api = an endpoint the program runs, listing = a page the program publishes without per-project counts, topics = GitHub's own signal on a repository, none = we looked and the program publishes nothing machine-readable. Entries with `projects: 0` carry a `reason` instead of rows, and a program is never padded to make a list look complete: Contribo's project rows were checked and are synthetic, so no row anywhere here came from them.

gsoc.label: Google Summer of Code

outreachy.label: Outreachy
outreachy.source: outreachy.org internship-round pages, held at public/data/otherProjects.json (program "Outreachy")

esoc.label: Eclipse SoC
esoc.reason: Eclipse SoC has no machine-readable project archive: on 2026-10-25 every api.eclipse.org path we probed returned the same HTML application shell (https://api.eclipse.org/project/listing -> 200, https://api.eclipse.org/mentorship/project/listing -> 200, https://api.eclipse.org/project/listing/json -> 200, https://soc.eclipse.to -> TypeError, https://summerofcode.eclipse.org/ -> TypeError) and soc.eclipse.to did not resolve, so we publish no rows rather than a scraped guess; full probe log in scripts/.cache/esoc-probe.json.

mlh.label: MLH Fellowship
mlh.source: every repository under github.com/MLH-Fellowship and the upstream repository it was forked from (data/mlh-parents.json, read via the GitHub API), each fork re-verified with gh api repos/MLH-Fellowship/<fork>

gssoc.label: GSSoC'26
gssoc.source: https://gssoc.girlscript.org/api/projects - GirlScript's live season board, cached at scripts/.cache/gssoc-board.json, each repo_url then verified via gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>

kde.label: Season of KDE
kde.source: MediaWiki source of community.kde.org/SoK/Ideas/<year> for 2017-2026, held at public/data/kde-archive.json (`ideas`)

sob.label: Summer of Bitcoin
sob.source: public/data/otherProjects.json (program "Summer of Bitcoin"), read from summerofbitcoin.org's project list, with each github.com link re-read via gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>

nsoc.label: Nexus Spring of Code
nsoc.source: nsoc.in's own live project directory (data/raw/nsoc.json, crawled from nexus-be-7xkn.onrender.com/api/v1/projects with every repo URL verified via the GitHub API) merged with GitHub topic search (topic:nsoc, topic:nsoc-2026, org Nexus-Spring-of-Code)

oct.label: Hacktoberfest
oct.source: public/data/issues.json.gz (40017 issues across 290 repositories, snapshot 2026-10-21) filtered to issues whose labels read "hacktoberfest", plus gh api search/repositories?q=topic:hacktoberfest&sort=stars

24pr.label: 24 Pull Requests
24pr.source: https://24pullrequests.com/projects.json (the current curated wishlist, data/24pr-raw.json), each repository then re-read via gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>
